programme.title: E6 - JJ's Birthday Surprise
programme.desc: Join JJ for his birthday celebration! His friends and family are setting up a surprise party, but things keep going wrong. From a party bus to a farm adventure and even a train ride, celebrate with games, gifts, and a hunt for Bingo!

programme.title: E2 - Zero Gravity, Shrink Rays & More Mayhem!
programme.desc: Get ready for some sci-fi mayhem with Arpo & Baby Daniel! The chaos begins when Daniel accidentally switches Arpo to zero-gravity mode, causing the robot & everything he touches to float around the city! Then, Arpo accidentally shrinks Baby Daniel with a shrink ray & has to search frantically for the tiny toddler. The out-of-this-world adventure continues when the pesky squirrel takes Daniel on an unexpected trip to outer space in a make-believe rocket!

programme.title: E2 - A Day of Cody's Favorite Things!
programme.desc: Join Cody for a day filled with all his favorite things! First, Cody gets to live out his dino dreams as he dons a dinosaur costume & pretends to be a monster attacking a toy bridge. The fun continues at school, where he starts playing a guitar & his classmates join in to form their very own rock band! Cody also shows his caring side as he & his friends encounter a lost baby duckling & lead the way to help it find the perfect home.

programme.title: E6 - JJ's Birthday Surprise
programme.desc: Join JJ for his birthday celebration! His friends and family are setting up a surprise party, but things keep going wrong. From a party bus to a farm adventure and even a train ride, celebrate with games, gifts, and a hunt for Bingo!

programme.title: E3 - A BIG Birthday Surprise!
programme.desc: Join JJ and his animal pals for Emmy the elephant's birthday! Play a game of musical chairs, go on a submarine ride to see colorful sharks, and help rescue Mochi's rubber ducky at the beach. It's an animal-filled day of fun and adventure!

programme.title: E6 - JJ's Birthday Surprise

programme.title: E2 - Baby John's Favorite Animal Songs!
programme.desc: Sing along to Baby John's favorite animal songs! First, the kids welcome a new puppy named Bingo to the family & sing the classic nursery rhyme about him! Then, the family acts out the story of Humpty Dumpty Sat on a Wall. The animal fun continues as Baby John spends the day at the aquarium & runs into Baby Shark! He learns the 'Baby Shark' dance & has an exciting dance marathon! Plus, the family dresses up like little dinosaurs!

programme.title: E1 - Solving the Biggest Mysteries!
programme.desc: Mila & Morphle are on the case, solving the biggest mysteries in town! When Aunt Augustine's new necklace is stolen, Detective Mila & Morphle find clues to track down the culprits. Then, Winston & the Bandits steal a time machine & use it to go to the future! Mila & Morphle must follow them to get it back. The mysteries continue as the Bandits steal Morphle & the friends must find him, & a body swap device causes a confusing mix-up!

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won't find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today's world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.

programme.desc: 《不良執念清除師》描述高中生「蒲一永」（曾敬驊 飾）遭遇生死邊緣的車禍後陷入昏迷，醒來後意外擁有超能力，原本無聊的生活從此產生翻天覆地的改變，與菜鳥女警官「陳楮英」（宋芸樺 飾），以及校內死對頭「曹光硯」（彭千祐 飾）三人一同展開了一場奇幻又瘋狂的打怪旅程。

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事。

programme.title: E11
programme.desc: 講述了三位大學時期相識的律師，故事圍繞她們在律師事務所L&J一同處理案件，特別是女性受害者的權益案件。隨著一樁牽涉二十年秘密的醜聞浮上枱面，她們不僅要在法庭上奮戰，也需正視過去深埋的傷痕與真相。

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 尹甲是首爾出身的奎章閣檢書官，以良好的聲譽和英俊的外表而聞名。有一天，他的身體被「惡神姜哲」附身。他體內的惡神與曾經暗戀過尹甲的汝里有著連結。汝里是一位著名巫師的唯一孫女。她擁有精神天賦，但她拒絕成為靈媒，而是成為一名玻璃匠。 惡神需要汝里的屍體才能升天，但汝里拒絕了。尹甲被附身後，汝里進入了宮殿，那裡有強大的女鬼和惡靈所困擾。

programme.desc: 講述了三位大學時期相識的律師，故事圍繞她們在律師事務所L&J一同處理案件，特別是女性受害者的權益案件。隨著一樁牽涉二十年秘密的醜聞浮上枱面，她們不僅要在法庭上奮戰，也需正視過去深埋的傷痕與真相。

programme.title: E23
programme.desc: 芭蕾舞藝術家譚思婷退役歸國，欲與當年被迫分開的戀人馮睿破鏡重圓，但是過去的誤會如同天塹一般隔斷兩人。如今的馮睿獨自一個人帶著孩子，生活如同深潭靜水，譚思婷回來如同一顆石子攪亂了一切。而譚思婷身邊也有一個默默愛了她十年的暗戀者，這次勇敢追愛對她不離不棄。馮睿和譚思婷彼此逃避對方，但是命運的漩渦卻不斷將兩人裡挾其中，令他們愛恨兩難。

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 在最重視了解自然災害和吉凶的日本有著世界上最古老的調查機構「全領域異常解決辦公室」以解決難以想像的「無法解釋的異常案件」。但似乎隱藏著一個巨大的秘密. .....人們面對的「異常事件」，例如無法用科學解釋的超自然現象。這是一個可能真實發生在你身邊的故事。甚麼是真實的，甚麼是虛構的？ 真相在下一刻就變成了妄想。

programme.title: When Sun Meets Moon
programme.desc: In 1992, a heavy rainstorm caused massive power outage in Hong Kong. At that night, two young astrology enthusiasts, Moon and Sun, met under the starry night by the seaside. When their affection to each other grew, Sun was admitted into a boarding school and would move to another country in a few months under his father's plan. Like the sun and moon, the couple could hardly see each other despite that they were living in the same city, but their love endured amidst the separation and opposition from Moon's mother. Overcoming the challenges from teachers, friends and family, time has come for Sun to depart...

programme.title: Don't Call It Mystery
programme.desc: One day, a talkative college student with a natural perm, Totonou Kunou visits Hiroshima for an art exhibition, and there meets a teenage girl, Shioji Kariatsumari, who says she is a friend of Garo Inudo. “Would you work for me? Lives and money are at stake. I'm serious.” She offers Totonou a part-time job, which turns out to be related to the succession of an enormous inheritance. Totonou decides to help her out, only to get involved in an inheritance battle of the noble and shady Kariatsumari family, where people have been killed for generations. Multiple dark sides and mysteries of the family are laid out behind the inheritance. What truth is buried there?

programme.title: The Lost King
programme.desc: An amateur historian defies the stodgy academic establishment in her efforts to find King Richard III's remains, which were lost for over 500 years.

programme.title: The Electrical Life Of Louis Wain
programme.desc: A whimsical take on the life of Louis Wain, a painter who was best known for his eccentric painting of cats.

programme.title: E11 - 張遠孔雪兒加盟風華悅己節 (下)
programme.desc: 由吳彥祖擔任「風華投資人」，集結井朧、代旭、沙一汀、周柯宇、常華森、董思成、謝依霖等常駐嘉賓，在杭州西湖邊的青春潮飲生活店，共同完成15天的運營任務，探索興趣社交的潮流生活方式。
